name: MetaMask Mobile (Expo / JS dev)
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24.16.0; nvm alias default 24.16.0; corepack enable; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/v24.16.0/bin:$PATH"; node --version && yarn --version && git submodule update --init && yarn install --immutable && node scripts/setup.mjs --no-build-ios --no-build-android

terminals.name: metro
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/v24.16.0/bin:$PATH"; export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192"; yarn watch
